note: Points are earned only by executable evidence. Weights sum to exactly 100 and are validated by scripts/v4/progress.mjs.

criteria.title: V1 main, V2 v2/main and V3 v3/main SHAs recorded before any V4 commit
V4 work happens on v4/main only; no merge or force-push to protected refs
No secret, key or token is committed to the repository
The V4 acceptance matrix is validated by code (weights = 100, evidence required)
Installable PWA manifest with 192/512/maskable icons and standalone display
Viewport-fit=cover plus safe-area padding for notches and home indicator
Responsive breakpoints for phone, tablet and desktop
prefers-reduced-motion disables the spirit animation
Touch targets are at least 42px and controls are labelled
App shell is served by the host with correct content types
Service worker caches the shell only and never API data
Offline state is visible and states that execution is unavailable
Living MAJIN spirit canvas bound to real conversation states
criteria.note: States are driven by server events and covered by unit tests; motion quality is not machine-verified.

criteria.title: iPhone Safari and Android Chrome physical-device walkthrough
Playwright viewport/visual regression for mobile layouts
Model selector lists host models with honest status labels
Pairing code is single-use-seeded, 0600, HMAC-hashed and never stored in plaintext
Sessions are signed server-side, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, expiring and revocable
All API routes except health/pair/me require a valid session
CSRF header and same-origin enforcement on every mutating request
Host-header allowlist blocks DNS rebinding
Rate limiting per client for pairing, turns and general requests
Request body size limits and JSON validation
CSP forbids inline script, framing and third-party origins
Workspace tool refuses traversal, reserved names and overwrite
Tool calls can never bypass the approval layer
No API key, Authorization header or credential value reaches the client
Plugin capabilities require declared permissions; undeclared use fails
Prompt-injection corpus cannot escape the workspace, schema or approval layer
External penetration test of the tunnelled deployment
Server-sent streaming of a real turn, tool calls included
Messages persist to disk and survive refresh/restart
Duplicate requestId is replayed, never executed twice
Cancellation propagates and is recorded as CANCELLED
Conversations are independent and correctly scoped
Errors are reported honestly and marked as errors in history
Conversation deletion is real (file removed)
A correction is linked to the previous goal as a revision, not an orphan
A second paired device sees the same conversation and goal state
V2 goal state machine reused unchanged; illegal transitions impossible
A file write is only COMPLETED after the disk verifier matches SHA-256
Every action produces a receipt with evidence
A goal left RUNNING by a crash becomes BLOCKED on boot, never silently completed
Completion is impossible without covered acceptance items
Tool throw, schema break, timeout and budget all fail the turn honestly
Resume re-verifies every acceptance item against recorded hashes before completing
Multi-step browser goal with DOM verification on the Windows host

categories.title: Existing Windows configuration and model routing

criteria.title: V1 config is read as the single source of truth; no second mobile configuration
Configured and discovered models are listed without secrets
An unknown or unconfigured model id is refused by the server
Model choice is scoped to one conversation and persisted
A broken or missing config degrades to a clearly labelled demo lane
Live results are tracked separately from "configured" status
Real inference through a configured provider from the phone
criteria.blocker: Needs a real provider key and outbound network on the host; not available in this sandbox.

criteria.title: Live catalog discovery via V1 code, TTL cache and refresh
Capability detection is honest: tap-to-talk, never advertised as continuous
Swedish/English recognition language follows the device
Permission, no-speech and network errors are explained to the user
Auto-send only a final transcript and never during an active turn
Markdown is stripped before speech synthesis
Measured TTS latency and barge-in on a real phone
Server-side TTS wired through the V2 voice lane (offline provider verified)
criteria.note: The V2 adapters, consent path, file verifier and HTTP surface are proven with the deterministic offline provider. A real engine (edge-tts) needs network to Microsoft and is not verified here.

criteria.title: Versioned kernel API with frozen capability contracts
Plugin manifests are validated and capabilities must be declared
Failed plugin activation rolls back every registration
Plugins are opt-in, allowlisted and experimental ones are flag-gated
Failing plugin is quarantined with a written reason and not retried
Plugins run in a supervised child process with stripped env and call timeouts
Benchmark harness measures pass rate, latency, receipts and replays
Automatic startup on Windows after login, with crash recovery
Health check and reconnect behaviour on the real host
A verified private HTTPS URL reachable from a phone
criteria.blocker: Requires the owner to run the tunnel on the Windows host with their own Cloudflare account.

criteria.title: iPhone Safari and Android Chrome open the real URL and send a message
criteria.blocker: Depends on H3; no physical device in this environment.

criteria.title: Session history survives a host restart in the deployed environment
Least-privilege account and desktop-session limitation handling
